credit.credit-words: He Is Able to Deliver Thee
WORDS and MUSIC: “Deliverance”; William A. Ogden, pub.1887. Public Domain.

Who shall deliver me from the body of this death? I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord. Rom. 7:24-25 The Deliverer... shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob. 11:26 Our God whom we serve is able to deliver us. Dan. 3:17
